items.title: Oliver Nelson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 10, 2020
items.q: Clark Terry said something once I’ll never forget.

ctx.x: Right. When’s that guy going to retire?

That’s right. Don’t do it anytime — you know my philosophy of retiring is I probably never will. As long as I can still play and do that kind of stuff, and for me music is to touch the lives positively of others. Clark Terry said something once I’ll never forget. He said you know what I want people to feel better when they leave than when they come in.
All right. Well that sounds like a good note to wrap up with. And I’ve so much enjoyed this conversation. I had a feeling I would.
